edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for allowance reduction.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_transfer relies on msg.sender-derived owner comparison for trading gating.
_approve receives msg.sender as owner during transferFrom.
setTrading is gated by onlyOwner comparing _owner to msg.sender.
manualswap requires msg.sender to be development or marketing address.
manualsend requires msg.sender to be development or marketing address.
blockBots is gated by onlyOwner.
unblockBot is gated by onlyOwner.
setFee is gated by onlyOwner.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is gated by onlyOwner.
toggleSwap is gated by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxnAmount is gated by onlyOwner.
setMaxWalletSize is gated by onlyOwner.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is gated by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner.
owner is read from storage set from msg.sender during construction.
constructor mints the initial reflection balance to msg.sender.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
balanceOf converts reflections via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection obtains the rate from _getRate.
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount below _rTotal.
_transfer finishes by invoking _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swap conditions are met.
_transfer forwards contract ETH through sendETHToFee after swapping.
_transfer can reach the external router swap call through swapTokensForEth.
_transfer can reach the external ETH transfer through sendETHToFee.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth directly.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee directly.
swapTokensForEth passes tokenAmount and path into the router swap call.
sendETHToFee passes the amount to the marketing ETH transfer.
sendETHToFee reads _marketingAddress as recipient.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
The external router swap can re-enter transfer logic before state settlement.
The external ETH transfer to the marketing address can re-enter sendETHToFee flow.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard after optional fee removal.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects fees through _reflectFee.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount and adds rTransferAmount to _rOwned balances.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to the contract _rOwned entry.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal via SafeMath to keep supply consistent.
_reflectFee accumulates tFee into _tFeeTotal via SafeMath.
_getValues computes token values with _getTValues.
_getValues computes reflection values with _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal for the reflection supply.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes the exclusion mapping.
_transfer compares amount and contract balance against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for both parties.
_transfer compares counterparties against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys/sells.
_transfer compares contract balance against _swapTokensAtAmount to decide swapping.
_transfer checks the inSwap reentrancy guard before swapping.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping.
_transfer compares balance plus amount against _maxWalletSize.
_transfer checks fee-exclusion status of both parties.
_transfer selects the redistribution fee for buys and sells.
_transfer selects the tax fee for buys and sells.
_transfer assigns _redisFeeOnBuy when a buy is detected.
_transfer assigns _taxFeeOnBuy when a buy is detected.
_transfer assigns _redisFeeOnSell when a sell is detected.
_transfer assigns _taxFeeOnSell when a sell is detected.
removeAllFee snapshots and zeroes the redistribution fee.
removeAllFee snapshots and zeroes the tax fee.
restoreAllFee restores the redistribution fee snapshot.
restoreAllFee restores the tax fee snapshot.
setFee writes the buy redistribution fee.
setFee writes the buy tax fee.
setFee writes the sell redistribution fee.
setFee writes the sell tax fee.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
blockBots marks each provided address as a bot.
unblockBot clears the blacklist entry.
setMaxTxnAmount writes the maximum transaction amount.
setMaxWalletSize writes the maximum wallet size.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes the swap threshold.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
renounceOwnership clears the owner, removing privileged control.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged owner address.
owner returns the stored owner value.
constructor calls the external factory createPair, an untrusted external call at deployment.
constructor assigns the Uniswap router instance.
constructor stores the created pair address.
constructor marks owner, contract and fee addresses as excluded from fees.
constructor mints the total reflection supply to the deployer.
from parameter drives the transfer logic and blacklist/limit checks.
to parameter drives wallet-size and swap-pair checks.
amount parameter is compared against the owner-controlled max transaction limit.
contractTokenBalance determines whether an automatic swap occurs.
takeFee decides whether fees are removed/restored around the transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is forwarded to the router swap call.
path local array supplies the swap route.
spender parameter defines who receives the allowance.
account parameter selects the reflection balance to convert.
tAmount parameter is split into fee, team and transfer amounts.
maxTxAmount parameter becomes the owner-controlled transaction limit.
bots_ parameter list is written into the blacklist mapping.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner.
_tradingOpen parameter gates all user transfers.

normalization_plan.reason: from is only used inside _transfer and should be folded into its function node.
to is only used inside _transfer and should be folded into its function node.
amount is only used inside _transfer for limit checks and transfers.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer.
takeFee is a temporary flag computed inside _transfer.
tokenAmount is consumed only by the swap function.
path is constructed solely to feed the external router swap call.
spender is used by _approve when writing the allowance.
account indexes the reflection balance in balanceOf.
tAmount is the sole input of the internal transfer computation.
maxTxAmount is the value written into the state variable by setMaxTxnAmount.
bots_ is iterated and written into the blacklist mapping.
newOwner is validated and stored by transferOwnership.
_tradingOpen is the value written into tradingOpen by setTrading.
